scope: Labelled origin supplements for June calendar names whose reviewed history gives no origin.
method: thin151.mjs 06-01 06-31 listed reviewed June histories without origin wording; r156-data.mjs + build-r156.mjs (generated by makebuild.mjs from the round 151 helpers and the O-blocks of rounds 152–156) wrote public/namedays-hypotheses-supplements-r156.js, merged by public/namedays-hypotheses-supplements.js. Lithuanian comparison names in two-stem notes are checked against the LT calendar (lt2check.cjs). Skipped: names whose reviewed history already explains the word (Ceronis, Gaida, Mundra group, Līgonis, Palmīra, Malvīne group, Žydris, Mantigirdas, Dovilė, Endla, Päivo), names without a secure base (Mairita group, Inta, Taive, Ards, Malva, Vidvuds, Manda, Ūve, Saivis, Baņuta, Milāna, Vaida, Aluona, Tanvilas, Deimena, Kaributas) and recent EE register names. Rounds 156–158 share writer 1.9.131 and the audit research/namedays/round158-audit.json. Wording follows the 16 November rules (no sources, no Russian attribution).
